Definition: from the same as G899; a step, i.e. (figuratively) grade (of dignity):--degree.
BiblicalUsage: Bathmos is a step, a grade of standing, and Paul says deacons who have used the office well purchase to themselves a good degree and great boldness in the faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that faithful service earns standing before God, and the good degree is the reward of deacons who serve well.
